item.title: momo 1.5
item.description:
Get anywhere from the note list

  • Click the note list's title to jump anywhere: Active, the filters, Quick Access and your folders.
  • ⌥⌘1–9 jump straight to Active and the filters (also View ▸ Go To).
  • A new Locked filter lists every locked note.

Attach files

  • Attach any file to a note: the paperclip in the style bar, Format ▸ Attach File… (⇧⌘A), or drag it in. Text files too.

Tidier

  • A cleaner box for choosing and typing your lock password.
  • The note list's top row lines up with the window's buttons, and a note's first line sits level with the list.

Fixes

  • New Folder lets you name it straight away.
  • The sidebar keeps the folder you chose highlighted.
  • The note list follows a note you move to another folder.
  • Attached text files no longer count as notes.
